모델: E52 ㅋㅋㅋ — LAB 편 전체를 영상으로(제작 절차 lab-whole-video · 짜임 lab-video-story). 11-26에 구운 펠트 판 아홉 장을 시작 · 끝 그림으로 쓴다
공통: One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera is locked off exactly as in the start frame: no zoom, no pan, no tilt, no shake. Keep the exact handmade needle-felt miniature look of the start frame in every frame: fine wool felt fibres, visible stitches, matte felt and wool; every object keeps its shape, size and colour and never turns into a realistic thing. MONGLE is the coral-pink felt blob. At rest its face is only its two glossy black bead eyes: no nose and no mouth. When its feeling changes, its whole face changes to show that feeling, as written in ACTION, always in needle-felt: the eyes may grow bigger and rounder, squeeze shut into short curved dark stitched lines, curve into happy arcs or droop under little felt lids; a small simple felt mouth may open, smile, pout or wobble; blush, a felt sweat drop or a felt teardrop may appear. When the feeling passes, the mouth and the drops go away and the face returns to rest. Open eyes always stay glossy black beads: no white sclera, no coloured iris, no sparkling cartoon eyes, no eyelashes, no human teeth or lips. Mongle has NO arms, NO legs, NO hands and NO neck, ever: no limbs ever grow, nothing ever sticks out of its body. It moves only by tilting, squashing, stretching and bouncing its whole soft dome body. LOOK: the same light and colours as the start frame, unchanged to the last frame. Apart from Mongle's own expression, nothing new appears that is not in the start frame. If MONGLE is not in the start frame it never comes in. MONGLE does not blink. No speed lines, no motion lines, no cartoon effects, no steam, no smoke. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. No sound.

클립.prompt: Medium wide shot from slightly above of Mongle on its mint-green quilt beside a felt phone lying face-up, from the start frame. ACTION: at 0.4 s the phone screen glows a little brighter for a moment, as if a message arrived; from 0.6 to 1.4 s Mongle gives a small surprised hop in place and comes back down, its face at rest with round bead eyes; from 1.6 s to the end Mongle leans its whole dome slowly closer to the phone and tilts it to one side, studying the screen. The phone screen stays a plain soft pale-blue glow the whole time: no text, no icons, no bubbles ever appear on it. Mongle never grows arms or legs; it presses the phone only with its whole soft dome body. Nothing is drawn over the picture.

Extreme close-up of Mongle's face lit pale blue from the phone below the frame, from the start frame. ACTION: from 0 to 1.4 s Mongle tilts its whole dome slowly to the left, then from 1.4 to 2.8 s slowly to the right, puzzled; its two bead eyes stay round and open, its face at rest with no mouth. The phone stays just below the bottom edge. Mongle never grows arms or legs; it presses the phone only with its whole soft dome body. Nothing is drawn over the picture.

Medium shot of the friend sitting cross-legged on the round grey floor cushion, holding the phone in both hands, from the start frame. ACTION: from 0 to 1.5 s he looks down at the phone with a small amused closed-lip smile; from 1.5 s his small smile grows into a chuckle: his eyes curve into happy arcs and his shoulders bounce up and down a little. The friend is the young felt man with short straight black wool hair with soft bangs, a heather-grey felt hoodie and dark-navy felt sweatpants: his face, hair and clothes stay exactly the same in every frame. The phone screen stays a plain soft pale-blue glow the whole time: no text, no icons, no bubbles ever appear on it. MONGLE is not in this shot. Nothing is drawn over the picture.

Close shot of the friend bent over the phone, laughing, from the start frame. The friend is the young felt man with short straight black wool hair with soft bangs, a heather-grey felt hoodie and dark-navy felt sweatpants: his face, hair and clothes stay exactly the same in every frame.
